ios.desc:
Join 1,000+ companies using Skovik to simplify expense reporting. Built for global
organisations to reduces manual work, ensures compliance, and delivers a frictionless
experience for employees and finance teams. From smart automation and policy enforcement to
international tax support, the system adapts to your specific needs.

The app is available in multiple languages, even if this description is in English.

## Features

- Photograph receipts and submit expenses.
- Track mileage and per diem, compliant with local tax rules.
- Automatic transcription of receipts, to reduce manual input.
- Built-in policy checks for fast, reliable approvals.
- Support for global tax frameworks and multi-country operations.
- Clear insights through reporting and analytics.
- Integrates with ERP, HR and payroll systems – like SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Netsuite, and many more.

Read more about Skovik on our website.
